messages:
omar: Notifying the group about last night's aggregation drift. ETA note: drift peaked at ~4.1% for 30m, caused billing mismatches. Opening a follow-up.
jess: Ugh. Is this the same pattern as July (consumer lag + partial window)?
omar: Similar surface symptoms but different trigger. This time ETL batch job `agg-window-rotator` missed one window due to slow checkpointing after GC pause. It left ~45k events unprocessed.
maria: I dug into logs. GC pause correlated with a large vector-emb batch write at 02:41 UTC. Batch size spiked due to failed retry loop. We're adding rate limiting and backpressure at the writer.
talia: I'll own the fix in the rotator: add a durable checkpoint flush before rotation + tighter timeout. PR queued, ETA: tomorrow noon.
sre-oncall: Alerting was muted for 20m because the drift rule was temporarily silenced by infra maintenance. We need guardrails so silence can't hide >1% drift. Assign to me to harden alert policy.
omar: Action items (compact): Talia -> rotator flush + tests by tomorrow noon; Maria -> writer backpressure + retries fix by EOD; Jess -> update postmortem and cross-link previous incident; SRE -> alert hardening and policy change by EOD. Omar -> run targeted reconciliation backfill and validate billing corrections.
maria: Reproducer snippet for writer spike: `for batch in backlog: writer.send(batch.slice(0, 10000))` causing memory spike. Patch will batch to 1k and async throttle.
talia: Test plan: unit + integration with synthetic GC delays. Canary target: baseline drift <0.25% over 6h.
sre-oncall: New alert: `etl_agg_drift_v2`: (kafka_ingested_count - etl_agg_count) / kafka_ingested_count > 0.007 for 15m -> page on-call. Implemented and live.
infra-bot: deploybot: Deployment agg-rotator/patch-456 to canary started (job id: deploy-7991)
omar: Backfill strategy: incremental window replay for the missing rotation id range. Script uploaded: s3://redwood-ops/backfills/2335006789-agg-replay.sh. Running now.
jess: Please post backfill checksum and billing delta after run. Also add auto-replay if the same rotation id fails twice in 24h.
omar: Backfill finished: reprocessed 47,912 rows, drift reduced 4.12% -> 0.09%. Billing correction job enqueued. Full summary posted to #observability-metrics.
maria: Patch merged to master. Writer now respects a max_batch_size=1000 and has exponential backoff.
talia: Canary passed 8h with drift max 0.18%, rolling to prod in 2h.
sre-oncall: I've updated the runbook: added step to prevent alert silence from suppressing drift pages, added checklist for maintenance windows.
jess: Great. Follow-ups: add a regression test to the nightly integration that simulates GC stalls; set auto-replay guard; schedule a retro next Tuesday to review all recurring span/agg incidents. I'll put owners in the postmortem doc and open JIRA.
omar: Adding auto-replay to nightly if same rotation id fails twice. ETA: this week.
maria: Also adding telemetry for writer batch sizes so we can alert on spikes.
talia: Ping me if you want a walkthrough of the rotator changes before prod rollout.
jess: Thanks team. Closing this thread once JIRA issues are created and owners confirmed.
